title: Three Kingdoms 8: Reunification of the Three Kingdoms Under Jin

series.title: Three Kingdoms 8: Reunification of the Three Kingdoms Under Jin

fullText.simplified:
第十章、分裂

    诸葛亮死后，历史进入后三国时代。虽然分裂的情况没有得到改变，但各国内部的局势还是发生了很大的变化。
    魏国的司马一势力一天比一天强大，他杀了曹皇帝信任的将军，成为魏国权力最大的人。曹操的子孙们虽然继承了皇位，但没有守住曹操努力打造的事业，魏国正慢慢由姓“曹”变为姓“司马”。251年，司马一去世，他的两个儿子继承了他的权力。254年，司马一的大儿子认为曹皇帝不听话，废除了他的皇位，换了一个能控制的新曹姓皇帝。255年，司马一的大儿子病死，小儿子司马昭成为新的掌权者。这时的魏国虽然表面上皇帝仍姓曹，但司马昭才是真正的皇帝，而司马昭也有着一颗要做皇帝的心。260年，司马昭杀了反抗他的曹皇帝，换了一个听话的小皇帝。从那以后，魏国上下都以司马昭为主。
    南方的吴国平静一些，孙权在稳定内部的同时，与越来越强大的魏国之间也保持住了稳定的关系。他遇到过军队内部将领的谋杀，也因继承人的不努力而倍感失望过，但他将吴国管理得还算不错，守住了国门。252年，孙权去世，他的儿子孙亮继承了皇位。但孙亮没有孙权这样的能力，六年后，他被孙家同族发起的叛乱废除了皇位。新的孙家孩子坐上皇位，吴国的历史在动乱中向前发展。
    蜀国的变化也不大。真的和诸葛亮去世时预料的一样，除了姜维，蜀国上下没有什么人再愿意北上了，“统一国家”、“收复北方”这样的话也没有什么人再提起了，就连皇帝刘禅也认为只要能在皇宫里安稳快乐地过一辈子就够了。只有姜维还在坚持着，他将诸葛亮的话放在心里，做着诸葛亮没有做完的事，他成为了蜀国的大将军，在诸葛亮死后的十多年里多次带兵北上。虽然皇帝刘禅没有反对，但姜维还是受到了蜀国内部其他势力的阻拦，有人觉得姜维是疯子，甚至还想杀了他。姜维不顾生死，每场战争都站在最前面。他不怕死，只怕死时还没有完成诸葛亮的心愿。但是事情总是不那么顺利，就像诸葛亮说的老天爷真小气，姜维也总是差那么一点儿，始终走不到目的地。
fullText.traditional:
第十章、分裂

    諸葛亮死後，歷史進入後三國時代。雖然分裂的情況沒有得到改變，但各國內部的局勢還是發生了很大的變化。
    魏國的司馬一勢力一天比一天強大，他殺了曹皇帝信任的將軍，成為魏國權力最大的人。曹操的子孫們雖然繼承了皇位，但沒有守住曹操努力打造的事業，魏國正慢慢由姓“曹”變為姓“司馬”。251年，司馬一去世，他的兩個兒子繼承了他的權力。254年，司馬一的大兒子認為曹皇帝不聽話，廢除了他的皇位，換了一個能控制的新曹姓皇帝。255年，司馬一的大兒子病死，小兒子司馬昭成為新的掌權者。這時的魏國雖然表面上皇帝仍姓曹，但司馬昭才是真正的皇帝，而司馬昭也有著一顆要做皇帝的心。260年，司馬昭殺了反抗他的曹皇帝，換了一個聽話的小皇帝。從那以後，魏國上下都以司馬昭為主。
    南方的吳國平靜一些，孫權在穩定內部的同時，與越來越強大的魏國之間也保持住了穩定的關係。他遇到過軍隊內部將領的謀殺，也因繼承人的不努力而倍感失望過，但他將吳國管理得還算不錯，守住了國門。252年，孫權去世，他的兒子孫亮繼承了皇位。但孫亮沒有孫權這樣的能力，六年後，他被孫家同族發起的叛亂廢除了皇位。新的孫家孩子坐上皇位，吳國的歷史在動亂中向前發展。
    蜀國的變化也不大。真的和諸葛亮去世時預料的一樣，除了姜維，蜀國上下沒有什麼人再願意北上了，“統一國家”、“收復北方”這樣的話也沒有什麼人再提起了，就連皇帝劉禪也認為只要能在皇宮裡安穩快樂地過一輩子就夠了。只有姜維還在堅持著，他將諸葛亮的話放在心裡，做著諸葛亮沒有做完的事，他成為了蜀國的大將軍，在諸葛亮死後的十多年裡多次帶兵北上。雖然皇帝劉禪沒有反對，但姜維還是受到了蜀國內部其他勢力的阻攔，有人覺得姜維是瘋子，甚至還想殺了他。姜維不顧生死，每場戰爭都站在最前面。他不怕死，只怕死時還沒有完成諸葛亮的心願。但是事情總是不那麼順利，就像諸葛亮說的老天爺真小氣，姜維也總是差那麼一點兒，始終走不到目的地。

sentences.simplified: 诸葛亮死后，历史进入后三国时代。
sentences.traditional: 諸葛亮死後，歷史進入後三國時代。
sentences.pinyin: zhū gě liàng sǐ hòu lì shǐ jìn rù hòu sān guó shí dài
sentences.english: After the death of Zhuge Liang, history entered the post-Three Kingdoms period.

sentences.simplified: 虽然分裂的情况没有得到改变，但各国内部的局势还是发生了很大的变化。
sentences.traditional: 雖然分裂的情況沒有得到改變，但各國內部的局勢還是發生了很大的變化。
sentences.pinyin: suī rán fēn liè de qíng kuàng méi yǒu dé dào gǎi biàn dàn gè guó nèi bù de jú shì hái shì fā shēng le hěn dà de biàn huà
sentences.english: Although the state of division remained unchanged, the internal situation within each state underwent significant changes.

sentences.simplified: 魏国的司马一势力一天比一天强大，
sentences.traditional: 魏國的司馬一勢力一天比一天強大，
sentences.pinyin: wèi guó de sī mǎ yī shì li yì tiān bǐ yì tiān qiáng dà
sentences.english: The power of Sima Yi of Wei grew stronger day by day.

sentences.simplified: 他杀了曹皇帝信任的将军，成为魏国权力最大的人。
sentences.traditional: 他殺了曹皇帝信任的將軍，成為魏國權力最大的人。
sentences.pinyin: tā shā le cáo huáng dì xìn rèn de jiāng jūn chéng wéi wèi guó quán lì zuì dà de rén
sentences.english: He killed the general trusted by Emperor Cao and became the most powerful person in the state of Wei.

sentences.simplified: 曹操的子孙们虽然继承了皇位，但没有守住曹操努力打造的事业，
sentences.traditional: 曹操的子孫們雖然繼承了皇位，但沒有守住曹操努力打造的事業，
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo de zǐ sūn men suī rán jì chéng le huáng wèi dàn méi yǒu shǒu zhu cáo cāo nǔ lì dǎ zào de shì yè
sentences.english: Although the descendants of Cao Cao inherited the throne, they were unable to maintain the legacy that Cao Cao had worked hard to build.

sentences.simplified: 魏国正慢慢由姓“曹”变为姓“司马”。
sentences.traditional: 魏國正慢慢由姓“曹”變為姓“司馬”。
sentences.pinyin: wèi guó zhèng màn man yóu xìng cáo biàn wèi xìng sī mǎ
sentences.english: The state of Wei was gradually transitioning from being ruled by the “Cao” family to the “Sima” family.

sentences.simplified: 251年，司马一去世，他的两个儿子继承了他的权力。
sentences.traditional: 251年，司馬一去世，他的兩個兒子繼承了他的權力。
sentences.pinyin: 3 nián sī mǎ yī qù shì tā de liǎng ge ér zi jì chéng le tā de quán lì
sentences.english: In 251, Sima Yi passed away, and his two sons inherited his power.

sentences.simplified: 254年，司马一的大儿子认为曹皇帝不听话，
sentences.traditional: 254年，司馬一的大兒子認為曹皇帝不聽話，
sentences.pinyin: 3 nián sī mǎ yī de dà ér zi rèn wéi cáo huáng dì bù tīng huà
sentences.english: In 254, the eldest son of Sima Yi believed that the Cao emperor was disobedient.

sentences.simplified: 废除了他的皇位，换了一个能控制的新曹姓皇帝。
sentences.traditional: 廢除了他的皇位，換了一個能控制的新曹姓皇帝。
sentences.pinyin: fèi chú le tā de huáng wèi huàn le yí ge néng kòng zhì de xīn cáo xìng huáng dì
sentences.english: He deposed the emperor and replaced him with a new Cao emperor who could be controlled.

sentences.simplified: 255年，司马一的大儿子病死，小儿子司马昭成为新的掌权者。
sentences.traditional: 255年，司馬一的大兒子病死，小兒子司馬昭成為新的掌權者。
sentences.pinyin: 3 nián sī mǎ yī de dà ér zi bìng sǐ xiǎo ér zi sī mǎ zhāo chéng wéi xīn de zhǎng quán zhě
sentences.english: In 255, Sima Yi’s eldest son died of illness, and his younger son, Sima Zhao, became the new ruler.

sentences.simplified: 这时的魏国虽然表面上皇帝仍姓曹，
sentences.traditional: 這時的魏國雖然表面上皇帝仍姓曹，
sentences.pinyin: zhè shí de wèi guó suī rán biǎo miàn shang huáng dì réng xìng cáo
sentences.english: At this time, although the emperor of the state of Wei still bore the surname Cao on the surface, ..

sentences.simplified: 但司马昭才是真正的皇帝，而司马昭也有着一颗要做皇帝的心。
sentences.traditional: 但司馬昭才是真正的皇帝，而司馬昭也有著一顆要做皇帝的心。
sentences.pinyin: dàn sī mǎ zhāo cái shì zhēn zhèng de huáng dì ér sī mǎ zhāo yě yǒu zhe yì kē yào zuò huáng dì de xīn
sentences.english: .. Sima Zhao was the true emperor, and Sima Zhao also harbored the ambition to become emperor himself.

sentences.simplified: 260年，司马昭杀了反抗他的曹皇帝，换了一个听话的小皇帝。
sentences.traditional: 260年，司馬昭殺了反抗他的曹皇帝，換了一個聽話的小皇帝。
sentences.pinyin: 3 nián sī mǎ zhāo shā le fǎn kàng tā de cáo huáng dì huàn le yí ge tīng huà de xiǎo huáng dì
sentences.english: In 260, Sima Zhao killed the Cao emperor who opposed him and replaced him with a compliant young emperor.

sentences.simplified: 从那以后，魏国上下都以司马昭为主。
sentences.traditional: 從那以後，魏國上下都以司馬昭為主。
sentences.pinyin: cóng nà yǐ hòu wèi guó shàng xià dōu yǐ sī mǎ zhāo wéi zhǔ
sentences.english: From then on, the state of Wei was entirely under the control of Sima Zhao.

sentences.simplified: 南方的吴国平静一些，
sentences.traditional: 南方的吳國平靜一些，
sentences.pinyin: nán fāng de wú guó píng jìng yì xiē
sentences.english: The southern state of Wu was somewhat more peaceful.

sentences.simplified: 孙权在稳定内部的同时，与越来越强大的魏国之间也保持住了稳定的关系。
sentences.traditional: 孫權在穩定內部的同時，與越來越強大的魏國之間也保持住了穩定的關係。
sentences.pinyin: sūn quán zài wěn dìng nèi bù de tóng shí yǔ yuè lái yuè qiáng dà de wèi guó zhī jiān yě bǎo chí zhù le wěn dìng de guān xi
sentences.english: While stabilizing internal affairs, Sun Quan also maintained a stable relationship with the increasingly powerful state of Wei.

sentences.simplified: 他遇到过军队内部将领的谋杀，也因继承人的不努力而倍感失望过，
sentences.traditional: 他遇到過軍隊內部將領的謀殺，也因繼承人的不努力而倍感失望過，
sentences.pinyin: tā yù dào guò jūn duì nèi bù jiàng lǐng de móu shā yě yīn jì chéng rén de bù nǔ lì ér bèi gǎn shī wàng guò
sentences.english: He encountered the murder of generals within the army and felt deeply disappointed by the lack of effort from his successor.

sentences.simplified: 但他将吴国管理得还算不错，守住了国门。
sentences.traditional: 但他將吳國管理得還算不錯，守住了國門。
sentences.pinyin: dàn tā jiāng wú guó guǎn lǐ de hái suàn bú cuò shǒu zhu le guó mén
sentences.english: But he managed the state of Wu fairly well and defended its borders.

sentences.simplified: 252年，孙权去世，他的儿子孙亮继承了皇位。
sentences.traditional: 252年，孫權去世，他的兒子孫亮繼承了皇位。
sentences.pinyin: 3 nián sūn quán qù shì tā de ér zi sūn liàng jì chéng le huáng wèi
sentences.english: In 252, Sun Quan passed away, and his son Sun Liang inherited the throne.

sentences.simplified: 但孙亮没有孙权这样的能力，
sentences.traditional: 但孫亮沒有孫權這樣的能力，
sentences.pinyin: dàn sūn liàng méi yǒu sūn quán zhè yàng de néng lì
sentences.english: But Sun Liang did not have Sun Quan’s abilities, and six years later, ..

sentences.simplified: 六年后，他被孙家同族发起的叛乱废除了皇位。
sentences.traditional: 六年後，他被孫家同族發起的叛亂廢除了皇位。
sentences.pinyin: liù nián hòu tā bèi sūn jiā tóng zú fā qǐ de pàn luàn fèi chú le huáng wèi
sentences.english: .. he was dethroned in a rebellion initiated by members of the Sun family clan.

sentences.simplified: 新的孙家孩子坐上皇位，吴国的历史在动乱中向前发展。
sentences.traditional: 新的孫家孩子坐上皇位，吳國的歷史在動亂中向前發展。
sentences.pinyin: xīn de sūn jiā hái zi zuò shang huáng wèi wú guó de lì shǐ zài dòng luàn zhōng xiàng qián fā zhǎn
sentences.english: A new child from the Sun family ascended the throne, and the history of the state of Wu continued to progress amidst turmoil.

sentences.simplified: 蜀国的变化也不大。
sentences.traditional: 蜀國的變化也不大。
sentences.pinyin: shǔ guó de biàn huà yě bú dà
sentences.english: There was not much change in the state of Shu either.

sentences.simplified: 真的和诸葛亮去世时预料的一样，
sentences.traditional: 真的和諸葛亮去世時預料的一樣，
sentences.pinyin: zhēn de hé zhū gě liàng qù shì shí yù liào de yí yàng
sentences.english: Just as Zhuge Liang had predicted at the time of his death, ..

sentences.simplified: 除了姜维，蜀国上下没有什么人再愿意北上了，
sentences.traditional: 除了姜維，蜀國上下沒有什麼人再願意北上了，
sentences.pinyin: chú le jiāng wéi shǔ guó shàng xià méi yǒu shén me rén zài yuàn yì běi shàng le
sentences.english: .. apart from Jiang Wei, there were few others in the state of Shu who were willing to march north.

sentences.simplified: “统一国家”、“收复北方”这样的话也没有什么人再提起了，
sentences.traditional: “統一國家”、“收復北方”這樣的話也沒有什麼人再提起了，
sentences.pinyin: tǒng yī guó jiā shōu fù běi fāng zhè yàng de huà yě méi yǒu shén me rén zài tí qǐ le
sentences.english: Few people mentioned the idea of “unifying the country” or “recovering the north” anymore.

sentences.simplified: 就连皇帝刘禅也认为只要能在皇宫里安稳快乐地过一辈子就够了。
sentences.traditional: 就連皇帝劉禪也認為只要能在皇宮裡安穩快樂地過一輩子就夠了。
sentences.pinyin: jiù lián huáng dì liú shàn yě rèn wéi zhǐ yào néng zài huáng gōng lǐ ān wěn kuài lè de guò yí bèi zi jiù gòu le
sentences.english: Even Emperor Liu Shan believed that it was enough to live a peaceful and happy life in the palace.

sentences.simplified: 只有姜维还在坚持着，他将诸葛亮的话放在心里，做着诸葛亮没有做完的事，
sentences.traditional: 只有姜維還在堅持著，他將諸葛亮的話放在心裡，做著諸葛亮沒有做完的事，

sentences.english: Only Jiang Wei continued to persevere, keeping Zhuge Liang’s words in mind and doing the things that Zhuge Liang had not finished.

sentences.traditional: 他成為了蜀國的大將軍，在諸葛亮死後的十多年裡多次帶兵北上。
sentences.pinyin: tā chéng wéi le shǔ guó de dà jiāng jūn zài zhū gě liàng sǐ hòu de shí duō nián lǐ duō cì dài bīng běi shàng
sentences.english: He became a great general of the state of Shu and led troops north multiple times in the decade following Zhuge Liang’s death.

sentence_translations: Chapter 10: Division
After the death of Zhuge Liang, history entered the post-Three Kingdoms period.
Although the state of division remained unchanged, the internal situation within each state underwent significant changes.
The power of Sima Yi of Wei grew stronger day by day.
He killed the general trusted by Emperor Cao and became the most powerful person in the state of Wei.
Although the descendants of Cao Cao inherited the throne, they were unable to maintain the legacy that Cao Cao had worked hard to build.
The state of Wei was gradually transitioning from being ruled by the “Cao” family to the “Sima” family.
In 251, Sima Yi passed away, and his two sons inherited his power.
In 254, the eldest son of Sima Yi believed that the Cao emperor was disobedient.
He deposed the emperor and replaced him with a new Cao emperor who could be controlled.
In 255, Sima Yi’s eldest son died of illness, and his younger son, Sima Zhao, became the new ruler.
At this time, although the emperor of the state of Wei still bore the surname Cao on the surface, ..
.. Sima Zhao was the true emperor, and Sima Zhao also harbored the ambition to become emperor himself.
In 260, Sima Zhao killed the Cao emperor who opposed him and replaced him with a compliant young emperor.
From then on, the state of Wei was entirely under the control of Sima Zhao.
The southern state of Wu was somewhat more peaceful.
While stabilizing internal affairs, Sun Quan also maintained a stable relationship with the increasingly powerful state of Wei.
He encountered the murder of generals within the army and felt deeply disappointed by the lack of effort from his successor.
But he managed the state of Wu fairly well and defended its borders.
In 252, Sun Quan passed away, and his son Sun Liang inherited the throne.
But Sun Liang did not have Sun Quan’s abilities, and six years later, ..
.. he was dethroned in a rebellion initiated by members of the Sun family clan.
A new child from the Sun family ascended the throne, and the history of the state of Wu continued to progress amidst turmoil.
There was not much change in the state of Shu either.
Just as Zhuge Liang had predicted at the time of his death, ..
.. apart from Jiang Wei, there were few others in the state of Shu who were willing to march north.
Few people mentioned the idea of “unifying the country” or “recovering the north” anymore.
Even Emperor Liu Shan believed that it was enough to live a peaceful and happy life in the palace.
Only Jiang Wei continued to persevere, keeping Zhuge Liang’s words in mind and doing the things that Zhuge Liang had not finished.
He became a great general of the state of Shu and led troops north multiple times in the decade following Zhuge Liang’s death.
Although Emperor Liu Shan did not object, Jiang Wei still faced obstruction from other forces within the state of Shu.
Some people thought Jiang Wei was a madman, and even wanted to kill him.
Jiang Wei risked his life standing at the forefront of every battle.
He was not afraid of death. He only feared dying before fulfilling Zhuge Liang’s wishes.
But things are never that smooth. Just as Zhuge Liang said, the heavens are truly stingy.
Jiang Wei always fell just a little short and never quite reached his destination.
